description: Former Museo Aeroespacial airframe (photographed at CATAM 2015) that stayed behind when the museum moved, now decorating the 'Silver Star' building (museum page, 2021). A JetPhotos/airhistory record titles it FAC2033/FAC2002, suggesting the painted 2033 may cover a different original identity.
